Status: Version 3 keeps every row and template of version 2 (the sales of S4) and adds the five example request types of 13m section 6.5 (FR-REQ-022, Q-REQ-01): BANK_GUARANTEE, FX_REQUEST, PAYMENT_APPROVAL, BANK_LETTER_REQUEST and FACILITY_DRAWDOWN, with their audiences (RQ, TM). They have no template and stay inactive: a type becomes active only when a template of it is published, and the template checks refuse one without fields. The owner approved this default on 2026-10-19 (Q-REQ-01: the plan stays inactive until the tenant gives its forms). A template already seeded under its SeedKey at an earlier version is kept. A proposed default written by an AI agent.
Sources: docs/30-readiness/DOC-F10 and DOC-F11 (template proposals DQ-F10-1 to 13, hooks DQ-F11-1 to 9)
Templates: templates/*.json: one graph per file (BankFas.Core.Workflow.TemplateGraph), stages and roles named by key and code.

NotSeeded.req.assign_number: The request number is allocated by the engine on entering the template's NumberOnStageKey (BR-WFL-013), so no hook row carries it.
